title: AION 2 Steam: Europe Launch Time and Platforms
description: Find the official Steam game, account login, supported platforms and available languages.
summary: Choose **NA West, NA East, Europe, South America or Asia** in the client. Match the region, faction and exact server with friends. Steam and the official PURPLE service share the same game servers.
quickAnswer: AION 2 is free-to-play on Steam. Public access opened on October 5, 2026 at 13:00 UTC. Install the main game, App 3393110, and sign in with your playing account.
